source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: the StyleSheet class with the same public fields (MUI subclasses it and sets before, and reads nonce, container, isSpeedy, prepend and insertionPoint), private fields and methods for the rest.
Style elements are created by the container's document (an iframe's head, for instance) rather than the global document.
The #is-development condition chooses development or production behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds.
verification.declarations: scripts/emotion-conformance/types.cjs compiles an application against the declarations with DOM types under TypeScript 7.1, 5.8 and 5.9.
